title: Reconstructing 3D+t Cardiovascular Flow From Sparse Planar Velocity Fields With Neural Fields
abstract: arXiv:2611.30775v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reconstructing time-resolved three-dimensional (3D+t) cardiovascular flow from sparse planar measurements is challenging because each plane observes only the two in-plane velocity components, on a small part of the volume. We propose a plane-aware neural-field framework that learns a continuous 3D velocity field from space and time coordinates through a per-plane projection, and then investigate the potential benefits of physics constraints. We evaluate the framework on computational aortic and aneurysm datasets, and on planes resampled from a real cardiac 4D Flow MRI scan. translated_title: 基于神经场从稀疏平面速度场重建三维时间分辨心血管血流
translated_abstract: 从稀疏的平面测量数据重建时间分辨的三维（3D+t）心血管血流具有挑战性，因为每个平面仅在体积的一小部分区域上观测到两个面内速度分量。我们提出了一种平面感知的神经场框架，该框架通过逐平面投影从空间和时间坐标学习连续的三维速度场，并进一步研究了物理约束带来的潜在益处。我们在计算生成的主动脉和动脉瘤数据集上，以及从真实心脏4D Flow MRI扫描中重采样得到的平面上对该框架进行了评估。在两个计算数据集上，普通多层感知机（MLP）的精度均优于经典的径向基函数（RBF）插值。对于主动脉数据，物理约束的SIREN（PC-SIREN）将相对均方根误差（rRMSE）进一步降至0.3756，而普通MLP为0.4273，RBF为0.7256，且PC-SIREN在每个解剖节段中都是最精确的模型。
tldr: 提出一种平面感知神经场框架，结合物理约束的SIREN网络，能够从稀疏平面速度测量中准确重建时间分辨的三维心血管血流，精度显著优于传统RBF插值方法。
en_tdlr: A plane-aware neural-field framework with physics-constrained SIREN accurately reconstructs time-resolved 3D cardiovascular flow from sparse planar velocity measurements, substantially outperforming classical RBF interpolation.
